# Proposal: negotiated host-restart intent for console-session migration

**Allocation-review proposal.** Prepared 2026-10-31 for qiin2333 and AlkaidLab maintainers. Posting is limited to these two repositories; moonlight-stream and LizardByte remain a later phase pending allocation-review feedback. A reference implementation is in progress locally; no new protocol implementation is published in a public branch yet. Nothing in the new protocol has run live.

## Issue-ready summary

SunshineService must respawn Core when the active Windows console session changes, including RDP-to-console handoffs. Today that orderly migration uses the same shutdown path as a real service stop. Remaining peers are sent termination type `0x0109` with reason `0x80030023`. After video has been received, common
### 1. Problem, evidence, and scope

The service launches Core in the active physical-console session. When that session ID changes, it terminates the old Core and launches another in the new session. Keeping the old process alive would not migrate its capture

### 5. Per-session emission and client recovery

Choose the termination reason **inside the host's per-session loop**, not once outside it. Terminal intent always sends `0x80030023`. Migration sends `0x53535201` only to that session's accepted encrypted v1 con
